what-must-survive-removing-policy-pins.text: What must survive removing policy pins.
As an integrator, I want to see each existing guarantee, the proposed replacement and the evidence still needed before trusting a registry without pins.

This inventory binds the accepted source revision in authority.md. Every candidate claim below is a hypothesis. Accepted declarations, statements, wire formats, application rules and guarantees remain unchanged; hypothetical additions are recorded below. Old definition digests are SHA256 of the complete source-file blob; theorem digests are the base register's statementSha256. A declaration existing or a digest matching proves identity only.

The eleven configuration fields are listed individually. The constitution's driver translation still calls config an "eight-field" value, although the bound structure has eleven fields. This discrepancy is recorded in questions.md; its text is not amended here. The proposed four-field datum does not authorize dropping registration cost or booking width.

unavailable-ledger-boundaries.text: The ledger vocabulary ticket remains open; its draft is unaccepted. The history ticket remains open with no matching pull request found. Required vocabulary is unavailable at the base: script-purpose invocation, applied script identity, full ledger values, accepted history, one-shot genesis and spent-at-most-once. These are dependency roles, not invented declaration names, and are excluded from declaration checking.

One transaction may invoke two state policies using one spent seed. Across-history spent-once forbids spending it again later; it does not by itself exclude this same-transaction case. Name-only registry binding remains unresolved. No competing ledger layer is introduced.

reader-meanings-and-asset-roles.text: The observation contract requires active application custody, pending termination, never registered, terminal and unavailable evidence. Existing held and leaf observations support logical census and leaf classification; world supply additionally counts genuine pending tokens. None supplies provider freshness/completeness or proves application/release identity from an empty lookup. A negative token lookup alone cannot select the other four classes.

State, active witness, trie-ready request tag and application tag occupy distinct abstract records or fields today. The positive trie-ready name distinguishes it from abstract state name zero; it proves no witness/request-tag separation under the proposed shared concrete policy. A genuine witness at the state address carrying a fabricated state datum still requires an authenticated full-identity/state-provenance proof. Wrong kind/key/registry, extra mint/burn and unrelated application assets remain explicit adverse cases for the later candidate.

consumers-and-compatibility.text: Implementation consumers are inventoried only: genesis, registry validators, configuration and identities, applied script parameters, asset names, transaction builders, and CLI creation, resolution and folding. They are neither edited nor evaluated by this slice.

Model consumers remain byte-identical: root driver/naming/lifecycle/permanent corpora and theorem registers; application corpus and theorem ledger; simulator mirror; coverage record; public model/theorem explanation and economics paper/register. No regeneration is due from documentation-only inventory; every future semantic change reopens its mapped consumers. No implementation evidence row changes.

The permanent translation keeps the two-edge law, fixed admission, applicable exits, datum delivery and public inputs. Its exact compatibility text is: "Registries from previous releases, including old Demo1 instances, are abandoned: no migration or compatibility recognition is authorized." The epic's exact architectural text is: "Existing registries retain their contracts and explicit compatible-release paths. New application policies create new state policies for new registries." The named releases and scope are unresolved; neither sentence is silently superseded here.

identity-premises-and-next-decision.text: Research records each proposition, its domain and a satisfying instance, separating executed premises over the existing model from written candidate examples. Questions gives the concrete starting state, competing outcomes, evidence limits and ruling needed. Unresolved means the proposed replacement is not accepted, including when the old theorem is registered as proved.

statement-audit-result.text: An independent statement audit on 22 October 2026 found the candidate ready to prove: twelve stated obligations and the true inversion of the rejected name-only reading, with two expected-refutable claims ready for constructive refutation. Nine of nine public cases have one derived inversion, twenty-nine mutants own all twenty-three guards, and fifteen negative controls failed for their intended reasons. The audited statement identities are statements.json 97450a8880920e1f81b97a02e2e449c76aec7baa9ae2b17fab63f7fc93fccb87 and lean/NoPin/Statements.lean 586c5ee86be8a691970ba245472e4d7be67303667242e42f53a905e6f2d838de in investigations/741-no-pin/. This establishes neither the truth of any statement nor hash separation for a real hash, provenance validity, ledger behaviour, or any custody, economic or reader claim. Separation among witness, trie-ready and application assets, and wrong-key and wrong-registry refusal for the authenticated reading, are not yet stated; they are required before any role-authentication claim.

The no-early-exit replacement remains current. NOTE-010 supersedes this section's cleanup amount; current cleanup returns only the approved deposit, as detailed below.

The registration-exit row above describes the timed routes. operator-money-ruling-and-every-journey.text: Operator money ruling and every journey.

Parent NOTE-010 delivers the operator's final Tip and Treasury directions for this candidate. Request value is the bid. The registration approval commits its deposit; the exact deposit enters its new holding, and the remainder is available to the folder. A termination request's whole ADA is available to the folder. No declared/fixed tip and no fold treasury share remain. Open datum pays its protected deposit to treasury at termination booking. These are decided differences from the accepted economic baseline and preceding candidate settlement, not narrowed equivalence claims.

The five immutable per-seed parameters stay present, but registrationCost and minimumTip do not set any bid floor, charge or allocation; their recorded values remain authenticated immutable metadata. The three clock fields retain their authentication and admission duties. Earlier identity/held theorems, ledgers and accepted source files remain unchanged; the new family must restate all affected guarantees, execute the changed journeys and expose their genuine provenance/ledger, hash/codec, funding and minimum-output limits. No implementation, hosted CI or acceptance follows from these surfaces.

The Registration delivery ruling delivered in NOTE-011 adds the narrow Singular holding-value check: verify the committed address/datum hash and at least the approved deposit, together with the genuine new token. The registration change carries the approved deposit explicitly, rather than treating received ADA as its own authority. Singular routes no money and reads no request bid. Open datum retains its own exact-deposit/genuine-token fold-path rule: open approval burning alone cannot establish that Singular folded. Delivery and application composition statements and their insufficient-deposit/no-token controls must both cover this distinction.

The bound same-semantics direction preserves refund-address signing for reclaim, with controller signing retained for booking.

The previous lifecycle audit and its ledger digest above remain a record of that earlier statement checkpoint, available at revision 99682696057a4ab4829067c57623276fa5faf1fd. They do not accept the corrected candidate. The old statement rows and functions remain historical; the refund-signer lifecycle is restated under new qualified names, and its ledger marks the supersession. The current money/oracle surfaces use the replacement handler. Both signing choices execute against both models.

The money candidate states create, registration booking and fold, payload update, termination booking and fold, full owner reclaim and deposit-only cleanup. Its party-by-journey grid distinguishes exact equal allocations from the ruled bid, treasury and timing differences. The old side calls the accepted economic producers; full old consumer/economic composition, real serialization, provider and ledger correspondence, output minimums, funding availability and inclusion remain external. Every general replacement and money statement is still unproved, with deliberate sorry debt. Compiled finite certificates and source substitutions are narrower evidence and confer no implementation or acceptance standing.

registration-payment-and-holding-address.text: Registration payment and holding address can coincide in the frozen money statement.

As a folder, I want the claimed gross bid to exclude a protected deposit that a new holding credits at my address, so that the amount described as my reward remains accurate. The frozen registration-fold statement admits a complete observation whose holding address equals the folder address: a deposit of 7 and a residual bid of 16 credit 23 at that address, contradicting its required total of 16. Lean proves the exact negation in Money.Refutation.registration_fold_journey_refutation. The statement has no authenticated booking-history premise, although the booking rule requires the holding address to be the application address. No reachable booking history or production exploit is claimed.

Eleven other frozen money statements are proved. The affected registration-fold claim remains held. The decision is whether a later statement should require authenticated booking provenance or measure the separate ordinary payment output. Preserving the frozen statement and recording its refutation is the outcome here; no definition, accepted application law or implementation changes. The full statement-definition closure is bound to a fresh compilation of the slice base.

corrected-registration-payment-claim-is-.text: Corrected registration payment claim is proved.

As a folder, I want my reward measured without the new holding, so that a registrant who names my address as the holding address cannot inflate it. A new statement, registration_fold_journey_holding_separated, keeps every premise and conclusion of the refuted registration-fold claim except the folder's payment, which now counts only outputs at the folder address that carry no newly active token. Lean proves it with the standard axioms only, and the earlier counterexample satisfies it. The refuted statement stays recorded and names its successor. The twelve original statement identities and their definition closure are unchanged; the new statement's closure baseline comes from the canonical Lake build. No party is paid differently from today. No accepted law, implementation, ledger, hosted CI or release acceptance follows.

history-guarantees-are-proved.text: As an integrator, I want the token-supply guarantees of the registry proved over every reachable history, so that a validator built from them can rely on one live token per key. All four history statements are proved with the standard axioms only: supply is one exactly for an active leaf and zero otherwise (supply in step), at most one token per registry and key is unspent (one live token), a token burns only in a fold that terminates the same registry and key (burn only terminating fold), and no accepted fold mints a terminal key again (no remint after terminal). The statement identities and their constructor-aware definition closure are unchanged from the slice base. No accepted law, implementation, ledger, hosted CI or release acceptance follows.
